memory_candidates.content: When a plan's checklist writes a Set-valued image as `(fun i => S i) '' Set.univ`, the form that typechecks against `Set α` is `⋃ i, S i` (the image is `Set (Set α)`); prove the generic `Set.ext fun _ => by simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Set.mem_iUnion]` once and specialise.

Prop-valued `structure` fields whose statements are definitional unfoldings of a `match`-defined predicate (e.g. `clTrace`) close with `Iff.rfl` via the `where` syntax without any `unfold`/`simp`; a `¬ c _ z` field closes with `fun _ _ h => h`.
